title: Anthropic Localizes Claude Pricing in India with Rupee Billing
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Anthropic has reportedly begun rolling out localized Indian Rupee (INR) subscription plans for Claude Pro, Max, and Team tiers in India, its second-largest market.
body: Anthropic has reportedly started localizing pricing for its Claude subscription plans in India, according to reports. The rollout introduces rupee-denominated billing for users, aiming to eliminate international transaction friction in Claude's second-largest global market after the US. Under the new structures, Claude Pro reportedly costs Rs. 2,399 per month (or Rs. 1,999 per month when billed annually). Additionally, Anthropic has reportedly introduced two higher-limit 'Claude Max' tiers priced at Rs. 11,999 (Max 5x) and Rs. 23,999 (Max 20x) per month, alongside Team plans starting at Rs. 2,399 per user per month on annual terms. While the listed fees reportedly include GST, reports note that local UPI payment support is not yet active, requiring users to pay via cards or app store billing systems.
